overall_label: 三阶段总进度 · 里程碑口径
formula: 总进度 = (MVP完成率 + 资产完成率 + 发布运营准备完成率) ÷ 3。三个阶段等权；每阶段内部只数已完成的验收项。不表示工时、花费或日历时间占比。

Overall = (MVP gate completion + asset gate completion + release/operations readiness completion) / 3. Phases have equal weight; only completed gates count within a phase. This is not labour, spending or elapsed-time percentage.

name: MVP 核心玩法定稿
MVP core-gameplay freeze
goal: 先把核心玩法真正做通、选定主线并验证稳定。
Make the core loop work, select the mainline and verify it.
exit: 最终测试通过，固定 MVP 基线。
Pass the final test and freeze the MVP baseline.

title: 原需求、反馈与限制回收
Recover original requirements, feedback and limits
deliverable: 以已有课堂纪要与源码为依据；新课堂意见之后再归入本作品。
Grounded in existing notes/source; new lesson input will be added later.

title: 共同核心规则与验收草案
Shared core rules and acceptance draft
deliverable: 保留已有核心循环，列出课内需要确认的变化；不是宣称新玩法已定稿。
Retain the core loop and identify changes to confirm in class; this is not a final new-game specification.

title: 可操作 MVP 原型
Build an operable MVP
deliverable: Opus/Astra分别提交可操作原型，当前两条都尚未实现。
Opus/Astra each deliver an operable prototype; both are currently unbuilt.

title: 分支评审与主线收敛
Review branches and choose a mainline
deliverable: 明确当前主线与对照版本；选择不冒充源码合并。
Identify mainline and comparisons; selection is not source merging.

title: 试玩入口与操作适配
Adapt play entry and controls
deliverable: 双语、单机、返回与本机保存；需要时加联机测试入口。
Language, solo, return and saves; an online test entry where needed.

title: 自动回归、缺陷与证据归档
Automated regression and evidence
deliverable: 已执行的测试、失败记录和修复来源可读回。
Executed checks, failures and repair provenance can be retrieved.

title: 最终正常流程测试 → MVP 定稿
Final normal-path test → MVP freeze
deliverable: 真实设备完整通关、关键边界与恢复测试；确认后固定核心范围，不再任意扩展。
Full physical-device normal flow, key boundaries and recovery; then freeze core scope.

name: 完整资产与视听呈现
Complete assets and audiovisual experience
goal: 补足故事与引导，强化视觉，把音乐、音效和配音制作成完整资产。
Complete story/guidance, strengthen visuals and produce full music, sound and voice assets.
exit: 完整资产包与故事体验集成验收通过。
Pass integrated full-asset and story-experience acceptance.

title: 完整故事线
Complete storyline
deliverable: 世界设定、角色动机、章节、冲突、结局与任务逻辑补足。
Complete world, motives, chapters, conflict, ending and quest logic.

title: 完整引导与可理解性
Complete guidance and comprehension
deliverable: 新手教学、目标提示、失败/返回引导及双语文案成套验证。
Validate onboarding, objectives, failure/recovery guidance and bilingual copy.

title: 资产规格与清单
Asset specification and inventory
deliverable: 锁定风格、格式、性能预算、文件命名、版本和授权来源。
Define style, formats, performance budgets, naming, versions and provenance.

title: 视觉资产与动画特效
Visual assets, animation and effects
deliverable: 角色、场景、界面、道具、动画、技能与反馈资产完整替换/强化。
Complete characters, environments, UI, props, animation, skills and feedback assets.

title: 音乐资产
Music assets
deliverable: 场景/情绪/战斗/结局音乐、循环与混音，形成可复用资产。
Produce reusable scene, mood, combat and ending music, loops and mixes.

title: 音效资产
Sound-effect assets
deliverable: 动作、交互、环境、能力和 UI 提示音齐备，控制响度与触发逻辑。
Complete action, interaction, ambient, ability and UI sounds, loudness and triggers.

title: 配音与角色声音
Voice and character audio
deliverable: 旁白/角色/引导台词、授权、双语发音和字幕，对话音频资产化。
Assetize narration, dialogue and guidance with consent, bilingual pronunciation and subtitles.

title: 视听集成与整体验收
Integrated audiovisual acceptance
deliverable: 全量资产装配、故事体验、音量可控、加载性能与多端回归。
Integrate all assets, story experience, audio controls, loading performance and device regression.

name: 平台发布、销售与长期运营
Platform release, sales and long-term operations
goal: 从作品变为能发布、交付、支持与持续运营的产品。
Turn the work into a product that can launch, deliver, support and operate.
exit: 完成正式发布并建立持续服务能力；运营本身不以100%表示永远结束。
Launch and establish continuing service capability; 100% readiness does not end ongoing operations.

title: 发行与商业方案
Release and commercial plan
deliverable: 选择实际平台、目标受众、销售/免费模式和服务边界。
Choose platforms, audiences, paid/free model and service scope.

title: 授权、隐私与平台要求
Rights, privacy and platform requirements
deliverable: 核对资产许可、商店规则、儿童数据、隐私告知与删除机制。
Verify asset rights, store requirements, children’s data, notices and deletion mechanisms.

title: 发行构建与兼容验收
Release builds and compatibility
deliverable: 发行包、安装/升级、设备兼容、稳定性、安全与恢复检查。
Test release packages, installation/upgrades, compatibility, stability, security and recovery.

title: 商店与宣传素材
Store and marketing material
deliverable: 商品页、图文/视频、价格、帮助说明与支持入口完成。
Complete listing, screenshots/video, pricing, help and support entry.

title: 正式平台销售发布
Production platform/sales launch
deliverable: 完成平台发布与购买/访问/交付路径验证，而非只有测试网址。
Launch and verify purchase/access/delivery paths, not only a test URL.

title: 长期服务运营准备
Long-term service readiness
deliverable: 监控、成本、备份恢复、客服、内容更新和事故处理可执行；之后按运行指标持续管理。
Make monitoring, costs, backup/recovery, support, updates and incident handling operational; then track ongoing service metrics.

coverage_note: 这里计算本轮两路重制的里程碑，不是把旧版完成度重置。第二阶段故事与完整资产、第三阶段发布运营尚未进入；现有原型视觉与声音不冒充正式资产包。
This measures the two-remake workflow, not a reset of historical work. Full story/assets and release/operations are later phases; prototype visuals/audio are not a finished asset package.
phase1_final_tests: 两条新候选完成后，各自正常流程测试，再做AI评审收敛和最终MVP验收。
After both candidates exist, test normally, perform AI evidence review, converge and finally accept the MVP.
current_note: 当前只完成原需求回收与核心规则归纳（2/7）；Opus/Astra尚未制作、未比较、未最终测试。旧版成果保留在历史区，不因重制而被抹去。
Only original requirements and core-rule synthesis are prepared (2/7). Opus/Astra are unbuilt, unreviewed and not finally tested. The baseline is retained in history, not erased.
